paragraphs.en: An optional discussion card names one fictional description from each category without choosing a true winner, and asks what the totals leave unknown. Reading alone suffices without retaking for a distinctive result. Equal counts establish neither breadth of taste, compatibility nor social position.

paragraphs.zh: 新增情境与讨论卡为费马编辑部原创；可以只读，原有观察也可跳过。固定现在愿意选择的一种普通自愿用餐设想，每对只比较文字呈现，假设食物适合自己，食材、味道、份量、价格与可获得性相同，不需购买或试吃。十二题每题二选一且全部完成；每类出现八次、两侧各四次，每两类相遇四次，选中记一次，总计十二次。全部最高并列保留；4—4—4是完整结果，混搭类别与双向或三向并列不同。没有反向、概率、置信度、营养分、阶层或收入估计；次数较少不等于厌恶，一题改选从原类减一、给另类加一，变化不验证特质或观察效果。原论文研究特定菜单且另测社会位置，仅作主题背景，不验证本十二组原创呈现题；本版尚无已建立的信效度、常模或中英等值，不推断原因、健康、创造能力或受众反应。讨论可全用虚构文字，不要求披露、饮食变化或消费。七篇全文始终公开；原有页面内存、自选24小时标签页草稿和完成退出重测清除不变，复制只含公开标题与入口，不含私人答案与次数。
paragraphs.en: FermatMind Editorial authored these added scenes and discussion cards. Reading alone suffices; existing observations are optional. Keep one ordinary voluntary meal you would choose now in mind. Compare only written presentation, assuming suitable food and equal ingredients, flavour, portion, price and availability within each pair, without purchase or tasting. All twelve two-choice prompts require answers. Each category appears eight times, four on each side; each pair of categories meets four times. Every choice contributes one count, twelve overall. All highest ties remain. A 4–4–4 is complete, while the mixed category differs from two- or three-way ties. Counts establish no probability, confidence, nutrition score, class or income. Fewer selections establish no aversion. An edit subtracts one from its original category and adds one to the other; changes validate neither a trait nor an observation’s effect. The paper studies particular menus and separately measures social position: topic background without validation of these twelve original presentation pairs. This edition has no established reliability, validity, norms or English–Chinese equivalence and infers no motives, health, creative ability or audience response. Fictional discussion requires no disclosure, dietary change or spending. All seven full guides remain public. Existing page memory, optional 24-hour tab drafts and completion, exit or retake clearing remain unchanged. Copying includes only the public title and entry, without private answers or counts.
